A CUDA program fails, or

span.p:
Does anything
run at all?

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
runtime reports error 3
cudaErrorInitializationError

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Number 1 is wrong
the KMD is below the family floor

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
upgrade the driver to 450 / 525 / 580
for CUDA 11.x / 12.x / 13.x

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p: cudaErrorCallRequiresNewerDriver = 36

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Number 2 is too low
the feature spans toolkit and driver

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
upgrade the driver,
or stop using that feature

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is the runtime's major version
the same as the driver's?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Data center GPU, NGC Server Ready
RTX SKU, or Jetson?

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
install cuda-compat-<major>-<minor>
and set LD_LIBRARY_PATH yourself

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
upgrade the driver, or take
an older build of the application

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
minor version compatibility applies;
look at the three caveats, not the version

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Do nvcc and nvidia-smi
simply disagree?

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Nothing is wrong.
Number 4 never decides anything

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

read CUDART_VERSION out of the wheel
